en: ...I'm not sure I understand.
I'm sayin' we get monkeys like you breakin' rules left, right, and center 'cause Nakajima won't train his drivers worth a damn.
Now just a minute.
Huh, figures ya'd get uppity. That Nakajima's a real scum o' the earth kinda guy. Makes sense he'd hire the same.
That circus he's runnin' is bound to go bust any day now.
Please, sir. Just let me say my piece.
Your piece, huh? Fine. I'm listenin'.
What happened today was completely my fault, sir. Nakajima trained me in all the rules to follow, and I failed to follow them.
I won't let it happen again, I assure you.
Please, accept this as my apology.
You call this an apology? You gotta be kiddin' me.
Grr... Hmph. Well, you just be sure not to break protocol again!
Well, you just be sure not to break protocol again!
Whoa! That's one hell of a treat. Well, you just be sure not to break protocol again. Heheh.
(I can't apologize without a gift. What should I hand over?)
(Uh-oh. Guess I didn't bring anything.)
Actually, I forgot to get you anything. Sorry about that, too...
Hmph! Surprised a fool like you's still got a job. Just be sure not to break protocol again!
I'll take that to heart. Thank you for your time.

This is wonderful! Seems like the tide is really turning in
our favor.
Only thing left to do is ride the wave!
I'm a little nervous...
Hey, none of that, now! You're going to be just fine!

Christina is here for you, and you know Park-san and I are
always in your corner. So chin up!
You're right... I can do this!
Yeah, that's the spirit!

Oh, I just remembered. I gotta head back to the agency, but
you should run on home.
You sure had a lot on your plate today. You must be exhausted!
I'll see ya tomorrow, then. Be safe getting home!
(Horie-san is right. It was quite a day...)
(I think I'll hurry home and get some sleep.)
(Horie-san's waiting for me at the taxi stand.)
*pant* ...Well, Christina-san, what did you think?
I have a feeling you and I will have a good talk, Haruka.
Christina-san...
What!? Why!?

Sure, Haruka danced well, but she wasn't <Italic>that</Italic> much better
than me! So what gives!?
My performance was better than hers! It doesn't make any sense!

It's just as I told you before, Akari-san. I only work with
dancers I'm interested in.

Look, I'm in a good mood today, so I'll share with you why
I chose Haruka.

Dancing is more than just technique. It's about how you
express your feelings, how you let others see what's in your
heart. That's the key.
My heart...?

I've judged countless auditions, and I've seen more dancers
than I can remember.

But the dancers who fail their auditions all have one very
basic thing in common.

They've let themselves become robotic, just dancing
machines.
Machines...

They perform perfectly calculated dances, without even the
slightest error. And yes, said precise movements are quite
impressive... at first.

But precision isn't what fascinates people. A true dancer
moves the audience with her ability to express emotion
through movement.

That's the difference between those who get their chance in
the spotlight and those who are backup dancers for life⑬the
difference between you and Haruka right now.
That's...

Don't dance for others' approval, Akari-san. Dance from the
heart. Show the world how you feel.
What are you talking about!? What's wrong with the way I dance!?
Forget it! I'm never going to dance again!
Let her be for now, Haruka.

She needs to figure things out for herself. It won't be
easy, but it'll be best for her in the long run.

But Akari's right. She's the one who showed me how much fun
dancing can be. She's been a good friend to me.

In that case, you be a good friend to her, and show her that
friends support one another and help each other grow.
...Right. I will.

All right. That's enough of a lecture. It's time now for
that talk I promised you. Something about work, was it?
Yes. I wanted to ask you to be my dance instructor.

Yes. Park-san, the president of my agency, Dyna Chair, would
like to speak to you about it.

And instead of coming to see me, she sent the dancer
herself... Actions speak louder, as they say. Heh, that's
quite a competent president you have!

So, if you wouldn't mind, I'd like you to come with me to my
agency to meet her.
Very well. Lead the way.
There. See that man? That's Christina.
Christina-san!

Hmm? You're that dancer from before, aren't you? I believe I
told you we didn't have anything further to discuss...
Yes, I know, but please give me one more chance!
And this time, I brought a pro.
A pro?
Akari, I don't understand.

Well, actually, some of my dancer friends told me earlier
that Christina was in Sotenbori, so I already came and had
him watch me dance.
But when I was done, he said he wasn't interested in me...

Christina-san, please give me another chance! Won't you
watch me dance just one more time?

I really want you to take me on as your dance student! I
want it more than anything!

I brought a friend with me this time. She's a pro, a real
pop idol!

That's got to be interesting enough to let me have another
try, right?
Akari, I don't know about this...
Come on, Haruka! Please!? Be a friend!

I don't have the looks or the connections you do. I can't
let this chance slip away!

...I don't know what's going on between the two of you, but,
very well. I'll watch you both dance.
You mean it!?

Wait a minute! I'm actually here because I wanted to talk to
Christina-san about work...
Dance first. Then we can talk.
I only work with dancers I'm interested in, you see.

If you want to talk to me, you'll have to first draw my
interest by dancing.
So what will it be?
All right... I'll do it. Let's show him what we can do, Akari!
(Trying to sober up, huh? Maybe he's taking a walk?)
Hi, Haruka.
Huh? Oh, Akari! What a coincidence!
Oh, nothing. So what are you doing? Shopping?

I'm looking for a man named Christina. He supposedly has
really tan skin and wears a lot of flashy clothes. You
haven't seen anyone like that, have you...?
No way... I don't believe it.
What is it? You're acting kind of funny, Akari.

Christina, right? Yeah, I know him. As a matter of fact, I
just saw him.
Hm? Really?

Sure. He was just on the Sotenbori Footpath. He might still
be there. Come on!

Excuse me. Do you mind if I ask you a question? Were you
just inside this bar?
Yeah. Why do you ask?

Did you happen to see someone with tan skin and flashy
clothes in there? I'm looking for him.

Tan skin and flashy clothes, huh...? Hmm. I don't think so.
I probably would've noticed somebody like that.
Hey, you see an old guy with tan skin and flashy clothes in there?
I, um, didn't say he was old...
Hmm? Nope. Don't think so.
I didn't see anybody like that, either.
Well, there's your answer. Guess not.
I see. Sorry for taking your time. Thanks, anyway!
Hey, you're pretty young. Should you really be out this late?

Park-san said Christina might be drinking at a bar or
something right now, didn't she?
Do you know what Christina looks like?
Of course I do. He's famous, right?
...You sure?
No, I'm sorry. I'm not really sure.

Thought so. He might be famous in our industry, but not much
is known about him outside of it. Since when did you try to
be such a know-it-all?
I'm sorry. I'm afraid I've never even heard of him...

Well, that ain't surprising. He's famous in our industry,
but not much is known about him outside of it.
Actually, I've only ever seen a picture of him once myself.
What does he look like?

Let's see. In the picture I saw, he had a tan, and he was
wearin' a pretty flashy outfit. Really looked the part, ya
know?
You'd think he'd stand out in a crowd, but I guess that ain't much to go on when it comes to actually tryin' to find the guy.
Well, we could ask around. Maybe someone's seen him.

That's true. Okay, where are the best places to go
barhopping around here...? Hmm...

Watami and Stijl Bar on Sotenbori Street are pretty famous.
And Crest Bar in Hoganji Yokocho is pretty popular with
those in the know.

How 'bout you go check out those three, and I'll go search
some of the less popular places?
We'll meet up later. Good luck!
(Okay. I'll go take a look.)
Okay, next up is continuing your lessons from yesterday.

But you must be tired after that. Why not take a little
break and clear your head? I'll be back at the office.
Thank you. I'll see you there a little later.
Well, we'll be going now. Thank you for everything!
No, no. Thank you.
Thank you. Goodbye!
Okay. Let's head back to the office, shall we?
Uh-oh! Careful, Haruka-chan!
What is it? What's wrong?
Look over there.

See that woman? She's been watchin' you this whole time.
Pretty suspicious if you ask me... She could be dangerous.
Dangerous?

Yeah. Some fans can get so carried away they start stalkin'
or harassin' their idol. You hear about that a lot these
days.

As your manager, I can't let anythin' like that happen to
you. You stay right here. I'll go get rid of her!
Wait, Horie-san!

You bet I'm talkin' to you! I saw you starin' at Haruka.
What's the big idea!?

What? And just what are you accusing me of? You think I
have any interest in that little country bumpkin!?
Bumpkin...?
Then, what were you looking at?

Well! If you must know, I was watching my ex-boyfriend. I
just arrived in town, you see, so I thought I'd look him up.
Ex-boyfriend...?

What's wrong with that!? Do I need your permission?
You'd better apologize for throwing around such outrageous
accusations!

I'm sorry... That was a terrible mistake on my par⑬ Wait a
minute!
Horie-san, you know her?
You're Yoko-san, the famous stylist!
Yoko-san?

Haruka-chan, you didn't know? Yoko-san is a world-famous
stylist!

With her hairstylin', her makeup techniques, and her
theories on health and beauty, she's second to none when it
comes to lookin' fabulous!
Oh, wow! It's an honor to meet you.

Oh, that's all behind me now. I'm not in the stylist biz
anymore. These days, I'm just a regular okama in heavy
makeup.

With your talent!? That's such a waste! Say... I know! Won't
ya consider stylin' our Haruka Sawamura here!?

Haruka-chan, if you were styled by the famous Yoko-san,
you'd be top class! Oh, Yoko-san, please say you'll do it!

Like I said, I don't do stylist work anymore... Besides,
there's no way this little potato face here's gonna turn out
to be some diamond in the rough.
...Hehe.

No? That's a shame... We really coulda used your help to get
through the Princess League.
Princess League?

Yeah, it's a TV show that decides the number one pop idol
in Osaka.

Haruka here is just about to go on for round one of the
finals. Would you like to come along? Just to cheer her on,
I mean.  Right, Haruka-chan?
Oh, yes! We'd love for you to come!

Well, we'll be going, then. Apologies again for my mistake.
Take care!

Hmph. So, the little country bumpkin wants to turn herself
into a princess?
This is the place. Wonder where the staff is...

Good morning. I'm Uda, chairman of the Sotenbori Merchants
Association.

The Merchants Association sponsors Sawamura-san's fan club.
It's very nice to meet you!
Hello, Uda-san. It's very nice to meet you, too.

And I'm Horie, from Dyna Chair. Thank you for having us
today.
Well, right this way, then...

Phew! Well, I lost. You're really good, Haruka. Silly of me
to go up against a pro!

*pant* *pant* Don't sell yourself short... You had all kinds
of moves I'd never even seen before!

Whew...! That was a close one... You're really good, Haruka.
Are you sure you've never done this before? Not sure what I
was thinking, going up against a pro...
That's the great thing about dance battles.
Win or lose, you get to see new dance moves up close.
That was a great workout! So what did you think of your very first battle?
It was tiring, but it was a lot of fun!
I'm glad you liked it!
I realized something today, dancing with you.

I've had so many dance lessons lately, I was starting to
think of dancing as work.
But dancing is more than that. It's supposed to be fun, right?
Right! And it's even more fun when you dance with a friend.

There are tons of dancers around here. If you ever want to
try another battle, just go up and ask.

They might look scary, but they're good people. I'm sure
they'd be glad to take you on.

There are some things in dance you can only learn on the
streets. I bet it'll help you out in your career, too!
